name: SimForge
shortDescription: Engineering simulations with explicit units, bounded solvers and reproducible reports.
features: RC discharge and spring-mass models validated against reference cases
Bounded parameter sweeps and central-difference sensitivity
Reproducible JSON exports: parameters, assumptions, formulas, versions
knownLimitations: Idealised models only (assumptions listed per report)
Sweeps capped at 1000 points; no background execution
